pack.description: Packs the project into one tarball with its package manager's pack command, making the outputPath folder first, as npm pack refuses a --pack-destination folder that does not exist

upgrade.description: Moves every exact version a catalog or a package manifest of the workspace pins, npm: aliases included, to the newest of the package's undeprecated dist-tag heads, or of the versions an installed package lists for a supported name, among those published at or after the pinned version, ranked by release, then stable before prerelease, then publish time, ranges staying as floors, then installs and deduplicates to move the lockfile, then removes the packages no installed project uses where the package manager registers the workspace with its store, as pnpm store prune does for a store outside the workspace
